article.hook: You hesitate before answering the door, unsure who belongs. Chiron in Cancer sharpens the ache around home - not the house, but the feeling of being guarded or left out.
article.lived: This transit stretches across years, unfolding in the quiet moments when we check if the lock is really locked or rehearse how to say “I need you” without sounding weak. We see it in how a generation handles vulnerability near family or chosen kin - when someone pauses before sharing a secret or folds in on themselves at a gathering. It’s the slow burn of learning where care is offered and where it’s withheld, day by day, year by year.
article.turn: The wound breaks open when the need for belonging turns into a barricade. You either build walls so thick no one reaches you or test everyone’s loyalty to the point they turn away. You don’t get to skip the ache by pretending you don’t need care. You have to face the risk of being seen to find the safety you want.
moves: Ask one person what feeling of home they carry and listen without fixing.
Invite someone to share a memory that made them feel protected or abandoned.
Set a boundary about your availability and stick to it for one week.
